description: Search live used cars on ingested NZ dealer yards, with the same filters, ranking and notes as the YardStock search page. Exact matches only. Returns `total` (every exact match) and up to `limit` of them. Not Trade Me.

city.description: A city, suburb or region, matched exactly: Wellington is not Mount Wellington.

limit.description: Default 20. Anonymous callers get at most 20.

make.description: Any spelling: VW is Volkswagen, Great Wall is GWM, Range Rover is Land Rover.

model.description: A model's name finds that model and every grade of it (Corolla finds Fielders and Axios, not the Corolla Cross). Anything longer narrows as words in the model (Corolla GX).

sort.description: Default: deal-desc when a make or model is named, else price-asc.

towbar.description: Only cars whose listing mentions a towbar.

name: search_stock
